frontMatter.title: Monday Club Night: Fixtures, Courts & Juvenile Times
frontMatter.summary: Shake off the Monday blues with Monday Club Night: Navan vs ESB (Division 3 Ladies), Navan vs Longwood ‘B’ (Grade 5 Men’s), 2 member courts from 9pm, plus Juvenile sessions (Girls 6:30pm, Boys 7:30pm).

prev.title: Leinster CAC Intercounty Prelims – Meath & Navan Players in Action (22nd February)
prev.summary: The Leinster CAC Intercounty Prelims take place this Sunday, 22nd February, across Meath, Dublin and Wicklow. Navan is represented in Meath’s Grade 3, 5A and 5B panels as they aim to join other Meath teams already qualified for Finals Day in March.

next.title: This Wednesday: Claremont Stadium Club Night
next.summary: Two big Grade 6 Mixed fixtures at Claremont this Wednesday: Navan A in a must-win league match vs Ardee, and Navan B in a knockout cup tie vs Athboy/Kells. Members’ courts open from 8:30pm.
